title: Themes
intro: Themes define how your album looks: colours, fonts, patterns, photo frames and the reactions your guests can use. Start from a template and make it your own.

list.mineEmpty: You don't have any custom themes yet. Pick a template below and click “Use as template”.
list.sharedIntro: An administrator has made these themes available to everyone. You can use them as a starting point for your own theme.
list.builtinIntro: There is a ready-made theme for every occasion. They can't be changed, but you can customise a copy.
list.deleteConfirm: Really delete this theme? Albums using it will switch to the neutral theme automatically.
list.adminIntro: As an administrator you can make themes available to the whole instance.

editor.contrastOk: All colour combinations are easy to read (WCAG AA).

contrastWarning.text-background: Text on the background is hard to read (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 recommended).
contrastWarning.text-surface: Text on surfaces is hard to read (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 recommended).
contrastWarning.muted-background: Secondary text on the background is hard to read (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 recommended).
contrastWarning.accentContrast-accent: Text on the accent colour (e.g. buttons) is hard to read (contrast {ratio}:1, at least 4.5:1 recommended).
